params.caption: 🕹️ Xbox cloud deal could grow GTA 6's Xbox audience by 30% A new Ampere Analysis report says the Microsoft–Take-Two deal that lets players stream GTA 6 on Xbox could reach an estimated 10 million "active" Xbox One consoles. That would expand the game's total addressable market on Xbox by about 30%, opening it to players who never upgraded to Series X|S. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 22:53 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @Xbox · @RockstarGames ☁️ Would you stream it?
